Credits and Purchases

Converting a personal photo costs the number of credits shown before you confirm. Credit packs are optional consumable in-app purchases processed by Apple; there is no subscription.

  • Purchased credits do not expire.
  • A submitted conversion consumes the displayed amount. If the service records the conversion as failed, those credits are returned automatically.
  • Bundled samples, painting an existing canvas, reopening saved work, and exporting do not consume conversion credits.
  • Credits are connected to the app’s anonymous client ID. Consumable credits are not automatically restored by Apple’s Restore Purchases feature and may not move automatically to another device or app installation.
  • If you lose access to an unused paid balance, contact support with your Apple purchase receipt and any available PicNum diagnostic information. We will investigate, but cross-device or post-deletion recovery is not guaranteed and may require purchase verification.

Apple controls payment processing and refund eligibility. To request a refund, visit reportaproblem.apple.com or contact Apple Support. Approved refunds or purchase revocations may cause related unused credits to be removed.

Your Content

You retain your rights to photos you submit and paintings you create. You give PicNum a limited permission to upload, process, temporarily store, and transmit that content only as needed to provide and support the conversion service.

You must have the necessary rights and permissions for every photo you submit. Do not upload unlawful content or content that infringes privacy, copyright, trademark, or other rights. You are responsible for how you use or share generated artwork.

Service Availability

Photo conversion requires internet access and working backend services. Processing time and output quality vary with the photo and selected detail level. We may change, suspend, limit, or discontinue parts of the service when reasonably necessary for maintenance, security, legal compliance, or product changes.

Paintings and progress are primarily stored on your device. PicNum does not currently provide account-based cloud synchronization, so deleting the app, losing the device, or clearing local data may remove saved work.
